■ Stage Direction
Age: Around 60s
Personality: Cheerful
Alright! On to the next one!

Everyone... thank you!
I'll give it everything I've got! Ready, set――!!

Ehehe~, maybe I'll hit the treadmill next?
Or dumbbells? Barbells sound pretty great too.
Ah! There they are! Hey there, everyone~♪

~! I came to enter the raffle!
I've got tons of tickets!

Waving back at Machikane Tannhauser were several children,
all running toward her with big smiles on their faces.

Hmm-hmm-hmmm♪
Where could they be? Are they here already~~?

The kids headed home for lunch,
leaving just me and Machikane Tannhauser behind.

Let's see how many tickets you've got... Haha, as expected of our shopping street regular!
You've got a whole pile! Alright, draw to your heart's content!
Ah, hold on, hold on! O-Machi-chan!

Machikane Tannhauser is adored by everyone. Perhaps the
affection of those around her is what keeps her so energetic.

Ehehe, I just had way too much energy to burn today,
so I ended up coming here. ――Munn!!

I see, what a coincidence~. I actually promised to hang out with some friends,
and we're supposed to meet up here――

Ehehe, I can't wait for the next day off.
What should I do next time~? Hmm-hmm-hmmm♪

On a day off, wanting to get some fresh air, I went for a stroll
and spotted Machikane Tannhauser at the park.

Ah, Trainer!
Are you out for a walk?

Long before the scheduled start time, Machikane Tannhauser
was already warming up.

Let's see~~... Let's play High-Ground Tag today!
Here we go! Clippity-clop, gallop and hop, rock-paper-shoot!

You worked so hard, so here. A treat of ice cream.
There's enough for two, so split it with your friend over there.

Yo, Machi-nee! What're we playing today? Cops and Robbers? High-Ground Tag?
I got faster, so I'm down for whatever!

Mmm, that's nowhere near first prize, the 'Hemokichi-kun Costume'.
But that was just the first try! Totally still got a shot! Right, Trainer!

Wait, but we might not be able to split Hemokichi-kun in half...?
Ah well, whatever. Let's head back to the academy!
Oh, we've been waiting for ya, O-Machi-chan!
You'll do great! You've got this, O-Machi-chan. Good luck!

――Wait, whoa! That's right, it's already noon!
Aaah, I almost totally forgot~!
Too bad, 4th prize!
Machi-chan, yahoo~~!

Haa, phew, whew~~. ...*gulp*.
Yeah. Alright, I can do this!!

Machikane Tannhauser kept waving to everyone for a good while,
just as cheerful as when she first arrived at the shopping street.

Oh my, O-Machi-chan. So nice to see you full of energy today too~!
The raffle is right over this way.
Next! Hyaaah!

Ah, I'm 'It'! Alright, I'm gonna catch all of you!
Run, run, ruuun!

Gah, 4th prize again. Oh well, can't be helped!
Next, next, next~!

That's right, you've worked hard to get here.
I'm sure you'll pull something great! You can do it!

Hehehe, curious? Want to come along then?
That way we can split the loot too~!

Huh, really?! Yay♪
Thanks, mister! I'll come shop again soon~!

*sigh* Sorry, Trainer.
I was hoping to split Hemokichi-kun with you if I won.

Yeah! Seeing the little kids and all the aunties and uncles around town
makes me so happy, it just fills me right up with energy!
The result of the final draw is...!!
Too bad, this one's 4th prize too!

A table was set up at the special venue with raffle boxes lined up on it.
Machikane Tannhauser reached into one... and drew!
Toryaaaaah!
Take thiiiiiiis――!!!!
This is the very last one... You ready, Machi-chan?
How about this one?!

Let's see... Ah, fourth prize.
Go ahead and pick another candy you like.

Machikane Tannhauser was playing around on the same level as the kids.
Her energy wasn't losing out to theirs in the slightest.

And the next day. Since strength training was scheduled,
I headed to the gym early to check the equipment—

Ei, mun!! Ei, mun!!
Ei, ei, mun!!
—It was fourth prize.

This is... Ah, fourth prize.
Too bad. Pick whichever candy you like.
Dosseeeeeeiiiiii!!!!

We arrived at the shopping district. Bustling voices and ringing bells
could be heard. It seemed like an event was underway.

Phew! Playing that much was so fun!
I wonder if everyone made it back home~?
